utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, if you can swing by the repair drive this weekend, that’d be great—there’ll be tools, snacks, and plenty of folks to help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll probably be a bit late, but I’ll still swing by and help once I get there. If you need me to bring anything specific, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Dane—come whenever you can, and if you’re able, bring any extra tools or small repairs you’ve got. We’ll be glad to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Nell — let’s keep it to Saturday morning, a quick look, and a short list of the main fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — Saturday morning works for me, and I’ll keep it brief. I’ll stop by and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — Saturday morning, brief look, then we’ll write up the main fixes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After school drop-off works for me — I’ll help keep things coordinated and simple. Do you want me to bring anything specific for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, it’s still happening today after school drop-off, right? If I spot anything useful, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it’s still happening today after school drop-off. If you spot anything useful, bring it along and I’ll keep everything coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll try to keep up this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Noah — just bring whatever tools or spare parts you can, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll bring whatever I can and try not to miss the updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot—if you can send the timing and pickup details, I can see whether I’ll be able to bring something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the timing and pickup details so everyone’s in the loop, and I’ll let you know what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — once you’ve got those details, I can check my schedule and see if I can bring the spare part.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Hana, we’re still going strong today—if you’ve got anything broken or can lend a hand sorting supplies, please swing by the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can help, but what exactly still needs repairing, and what time does the drive start?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Hana — we’re mainly fixing small household stuff, and there’s still plenty to sort and haul too. Just head over to the community center parking lot now, and I’ll point you to what needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, could you check what’s still left on the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yeah — I’m a bit scattered, but I can check. I know we still need old hand tools, extension cords, and a sturdy ladder.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Oren — that’s helpful. Can you tell me if anything else is still missing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just point me to the porch area and I’ll start with the easiest fix.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — the porch is right by the front entrance, and I really appreciate you starting with the easiest fix.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll head to the porch by the front entrance and get started there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got the repair drive marked by the community center parking lot, past the library. If it moves, I’ll flag it right away.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know the community center parking lot past the library is still the spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep that spot noted and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — could you bring the screwdriver set, gloves, and duct tape?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll bring the screwdriver set, gloves, and duct tape to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — that covers it. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Rey — I can help if you still need a hand, and I’ll keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — I’m checking the timing and where we can store everything. If you hear back from Cleo, I can bring the nails and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll let you know if I hear from Cleo, and I can help keep an eye on the storage setup too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, and I’ll keep an eye out for hand tools, extension cords, and a sturdy ladder for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a huge help for the repair drive. Just let me know if you want me to bring anything from my toolkit too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus — if you’ve got any extra screwdrivers, gloves, or duct tape, those would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and keep everyone in the loop — and I’ll keep an eye out for any old hand tools, extension cords, or a sturdy ladder too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Vik — thanks for spreading the word. If you spot any tools, just let me know and I’ll set mine aside too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still checking the timing and storage details, but I can bring nails and spare parts if Cleo needs them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — can you confirm what’s still needed and when the drive starts? I want to make sure before I help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the timing, but we’re mainly short on tools, patch kits, nails, and a few spare parts. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm when the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a screwdriver set, gloves, and duct tape. Let me know if you need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s perfect, Leo — those will be a big help. I’ll let you know if anything else comes up before Saturday morning at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll bring those Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Dane — happy to help with the repair drive. Just point me to the first thing you want me to look at.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I’ll be a bit late, but I’ll still come by and help once I get there. If you need me to bring anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No problem, Dane — just bring yourself when you can, and I’ll keep things moving until you get here.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone has the spot and timing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just confirming — it’s still on for today, right? I’ll keep an eye out for any tools or the ladder.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it’s still on for today — I’ll keep everyone posted on the spot and timing, and the porch light is still the first priority.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m heading over by the community center parking lot and will look for you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll be around the community center parking lot, just past the library. If the spot changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll head there now and look for you by the lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—if you can make it this weekend, bring anything broken or even a few supplies, and I’ll point you where you’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like it’s coming together nicely—I’ll pass that along and see what else people might need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Nell—that’d be a huge help. We’re still hoping for a big turnout, so any word you can spread will make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking in on the repair list—what’s still left to fix for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been out running errands, and I’m still keeping an eye out for the bigger needs—old hand tools, extension cords, or a sturdy ladder. If you’ve got the latest list, I can help spot anything else while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — I’ll send the latest list over. If you spot any hand tools, extension cords, or a sturdy ladder, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, you should come by the repair drive this weekend—we’ve got tools, snacks, and plenty of folks ready to help. If you’ve got anything broken or a few supplies to spare, bring them along!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll try to swing by and bring what I can. If I spot any old hand tools, extension cords, or a sturdy ladder, I’ll set them aside too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be perfect, Oren—those tools and the ladder would be a big help. Come by whenever you can this weekend, and I’ll point you to the right spot when you arrive!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that quiet help really means a lot. Sunday at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll let you know what’s left to cover.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, Rosa — just let me know what’s left, and I’ll help keep it quiet on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send you the latest list once I’ve checked what’s still needed. Your quiet support makes this a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good—I can stop by after school drop-off. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works best for me—how about 9:00 at the repair spot? Then we can do a quick look and list the main fixes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 9:00 works for me—I’ll swing by after drop-off with the things I’ve got. See you Saturday morning.
